answer.reason: The verses tell of its gilding, the placing of the ark in it, and the high priest's yearly entry, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was overlaid with pure gold by Solomon
clauses.quote: he overlaid it with pure gold

clauses.english: received the ark of the covenant under the wings of the cherubims
clauses.quote: into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place

clauses.english: was entered only by the high priest, once a year, with blood
clauses.quote: into the second went the high priest alone once every year

doubts: Verses from Leviticus 16 and Hebrews 9 on Christ entering the holy place were left out as not marked or as interpretation.
Several marked verses (1KI 6:5, 7:49-50, 2CH 4:20, 2CH 3:16) mention the oracle only as a location, so they were not used.
